changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: DevErrorLogSpecification.byFilter filters by traceId, but no index backed it - every GET /v1/dev/errors?traceId=... forced a full table scan for both the page query and its COUNT(*).

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: The dashboard's dominant query shape is "errors with this status in this time range" (status + occurred_at together). The existing single-column indexes let Postgres bitmap-AND them, but a composite index serves that combination directly as the table grows.

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: DevLoginHistorySpecification.byFilter filters by success, which had no index - typically combined with an occurred_at range for "recent failed logins" style queries.
